title: Juventus release stunning vineyard-inspired 2025/26 third kitShare on FacebookShare on XShare on Reddit
text:
Juventus have unveiled their third kit for the 2025/26 season – a stunning release inspired by the vineyards of Piedmont, the region the club calls home.

Continuing the club’s seasonal storytelling of Italian Excellence, the third jersey forms the next chapter in a narrative that began with a fashion-inspired home kit and a summer-celebrating away strip. This time, the focus turns to another cultural pillar of the region: wine.

The shirt features a grape-inspired engineered graphic that runs subtly across the body, with a refined colour palette of black, burgundy, and dark green. Adding to the classic feel, adidas’ Trefoil logo makes its return, just as it did on last season’s third kit, while Juventus’ iconic Zebra crest also takes pride of place.

A surprise twist comes with the dark green Three Stripes, which run across the shoulders, adding a contemporary edge to the retro detailing. A flat-knit V-neck collar and sleeve cuffs round off the design, balancing modern tailoring with vintage cues.

The kit is completed with black shorts featuring off-white accents on the club crest and matching dark green Three Stripes, alongside black socks that tie the look together.

The Juventus 2025/26 third kit is available now through adidas and the club’s official online store, as well as select global retailers.
